instance_contract.immutability_rule: A submitted rating is append-only; a correction creates a successor rating_id/revision with explicit lineage in the scoring run.

name: Criterion Rating

orthogonality_rules.statement: One record is one rater/scorer, response, case, rubric dimension and version; a Scoring Run groups it and an Adjudication resolves conflicts separately.
NA means no fair opportunity and UNK means unusable evidence; neither is numeric zero.
Anchors 2–4 require cited evidence; anchors 0–1 require a cited missed opportunity or contradiction.
A rating does not establish a stable trait, session score, product claim or employment decision.
